			limit = { has_variable = oe_pmng_events_fired }
			change_variable = { name = oe_pmng_events_fired add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_events_fired value = 1 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_pmng.16.a
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
				oe_pmng_init_host = yes
				if = {
					limit = { owns = location:shangyuan }
					set_capital = location:shangyuan
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { owns = location:guangzhou }
					set_capital = location:guangzhou
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { owns = location:minxian }
					set_capital = location:minxian
				}
				add_stability = 5
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_mod_southern_ming_rally years = 25 mode = replace }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_pmng.16.b
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
				oe_pmng_init_host = yes
				oe_pmng_add_haijin = { amt = 20 }
				add_gold = 150
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_mod_southern_ming_rally years = 25 mode = replace }
	}
}

oe_pmng.90 = {

	orphan = yes
	title = oe_pmng.90.title
	desc = oe_pmng.90.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_pmng_single_whip.dds"

	}
